display.title: Ahavas Yisroel: Love Your Fellow as Yourself, a Great Rule of the Torah
display.summary_short: Rabbi Akiva called loving your fellow as yourself a great rule of the Torah. Uncle Yossi explains why loving every Jew leads to loving Hashem.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. The Torah commands us to love our fellow as much as we love ourselves, and Rabbi Akiva taught that this is not just one more rule but a great rule of the whole Torah. When we truly love one another, we are able to love Hashem and keep all the other mitzvos. As the Alter Rebbe said, Ahavas Yisroel leads to Ahavas Hashem. Uncle Yossi gives a simple example: if you love a friend, you show it by loving the friends he loves too. Hashem says He loves every single Jew, so to show our love for Hashem we must openly love everyone whom Hashem loves.
display.lesson: To show that you love Hashem, love every Jew, because Hashem loves each one of them.
